brief:
A sand embankment collapsed onto displacement tents in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, killing five Palestinians including three children and two women, the Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred as torrential rain and severe weather struck the area.

Thousands of Palestinians are sheltering in makeshift camps across Gaza after being displaced by fighting. The collapse occurred during heavy rainfall that has battered the encampments in recent days.

title: Sand embankment collapse kills five Palestinians in Gaza displacement camp
